mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews(review_id, rating, comment, author_name, author_image_url, created_at, updated_at, user_id, product_id) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{rating}, #{comment}, #{authorName}, #{authorImageUrl}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId}, #{productId} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId})
SELECT product_id AS productId, AVG("rating") AS rating, COUNT("rating") AS count FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY product_id
SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM reviews r INNER JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reviews WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND user_id = #{userId}
